content: Yosue u Isirelibɑn bwesenu kpuro mɛnnɑ Sikɛmuɔ mɑ u ben ɡuro ɡurobu sokɑ kɑ ben wiruɡibu kɑ ben siri kowobu kɑ ben tɑbu sinɑmbu. Mɑ bɑ ben tii tusiɑ Gusunɔn wuswɑɑɔ.
Mɑ Gusunɔ Isirelibɑn Yinni u be kpuro sɔ̃ɔwɑ sɑɑ Yosuen nɔɔn di u nɛɛ, yellu, bɛɛn bɑɑbɑbɑ bɑ wɑ̃ɑ dɑɑ te bɑ mɔ̀ Efɑrɑtin ɡuruɔ. Miyɑ bɑ bũnu sɑ̃ɑmɔ. Ben turowɑ Terɑ, Aburɑhɑmu kɑ Nɑkorin tundo.
Mɑ nɑ bɛɛn bɑɑbɑ Aburɑhɑmu yɑrɑ sɑɑ dɑɑ ten berɑ ɡiɔn di. Nɑ derɑ u bɔsu Kɑnɑnin tem kpuro sɔɔ mɑ nɑ win bibu dɑbiɑsiɑ. Nɑ nùn Isɑki kɑ̃.
Mɑ nɑ mɑɑ Isɑki Yɑkɔbu kɑ Esɑu kɑ̃. Nɑ Esɑu Seirin ɡuuru ɡiɑ wɛ̃ u n mɔ, ɑdɑmɑ Yɑkɔbu kɑ win bibu, be, bɑ dɑwɑ Eɡibiti ɡiɑ.
Nɑ Mɔwisi kɑ Aroni ɡɔrɑ Eɡibitiɡibun mi. Mɑ nɑ Eɡibitiɡii be tɔ̃yɑ kuɑ kɑ ɡɑ̃ɑ mɑɑmɑɑkiɡii ni nɑ kuɑ. Yen biru nɑ bɛɛ Isirelibɑ yɑrɑ min di.
Ye nɑ bɛɛn bɑɑbɑbɑ yɑrɑ min di, mɑ Eɡibitiɡibɑ bu nɑɑ ɡirɑ kɑ ben tɑbu kɛkɛbɑ kɑ mɑɑsɔbu. Sɑɑ ye bɛɛn bɑɑbɑ be, bɑ turɑ nim wɔ̃kuɔ ɡe bɑ mɔ̀ Nɑɑ yɑri,

miyɑ bɑ mɑn nɔɔɡiru sue mɑ nɑ yɑm wɔ̃kuru doke be kɑ Eɡibitiɡibun bɑɑ sɔɔ. Nɑ derɑ nim wɔ̃kun nim mɛ, mu Eɡibitiɡii be wukiri bɑ nim diirɑ. Bɛɛn bɑɑbɑbɑ bɑ wɑ kɑ nɔni ye nɑ Eɡibitiɡibu kuɑ. Yen biru i wɔ̃ɔ dɑbinu kuɑ ɡbɑburɔ.
Mɑ nɑ kɑ bɛɛ nɑ Amɔrebɑn temɔ be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Yuudɛnin ɡuru ɡiɔ. Bɑ kɑ bɛɛ sɑnnɑ, nɑ mɑɑ bɛɛ bu nɔmu bɛriɑ, mɑ ben tem mu kuɑ bɛɛɡim. Mɑ nɑ bu kpeerɑsiɑ bɛɛn wuswɑɑɔ.
Bɑlɑki, Siporin bii, Mɔɑbun sunɔ, u seewɑ u kɑ bɛɛ tɑbu kuɑ. U Bɑlɑmu Beorin bii sokusiɑ u nɑ u bɛɛ bɔ̃rusi.
Adɑmɑ nɑ yinɑ n Bɑlɑmun ɡere swɑɑ dɑki mɑ nɑ derɑ u bɛɛ domɑru kuɑ, mɑ nɑ bɛɛ wɔrɑ Bɑlɑkin nɔmɑn di.
Yen biru i Yuudɛni tɔburɑ i turɑ Yerikoɔ, mɑ Yerikoɡibu kɑ Amɔrebɑ kɑ Feresibɑ kɑ Kɑnɑnibɑ kɑ Hɛtibɑ kɑ Giriɡɑsibɑ kɑ Hefibɑ kɑ Yebusibɑ bɑ bɛɛ sɑnnɔ seesi. Mɑ nɑ bɛɛ bu nɔmu bɛriɑ.
Nɑ susu bɑkɑnu ɡɔrɑ bɛɛn wuswɑɑɔ, nu bu ɡirɑ nɡe mɛ nu Amɔrebɑn sinɑmbu yiru ye kuɑ. N ǹ mɔ bɛɛn tɑkobibɑ, ǹ kun mɛ bɛɛn tɛnnu i kɑ bu kɑmiɑ.
Nɑ bɛɛ ɡbeɑ wɛ̃ ye i ǹ kɑsire, kɑ wusu mi i wɑ̃ɑ si i ǹ bɑnɛ, kɑ dɑ̃ɑ yèn binu i dimɔ ye i ǹ duure.
Yen biru Yosue u nɛɛ, yen sɔ̃, i de i Yinni Gusunɔ nɑsiɑ kpɑ i nùn sɑ̃ kɑ ɡɔ̃ru teu kɑ bɔrɔkiniru. I bɛɛn bɑɑbɑbɑn bũnu derio ni bɑ rɑɑ sɑ̃ɑmɔ dɑɑ te bɑ mɔ̀ Efɑrɑtin ɡuruɔ kɑ mɑɑ Eɡibitiɔ.

Ì kun mɑɑ kĩ i Gusunɔ sɑ̃, i ɡɔsio ɡisɔ wi i ko i sɑ̃, ǹ n bũnun nɑ, ni bɛsɛn bɑɑbɑbɑ bɑ sɑ̃wɑ dɑɑ ten ɡuruɔ, ǹ n mɑɑ Amɔrebɑɡinun nɑ, bèn temɔ i wɑ̃ɑ mi. Adɑmɑ nɛ kɑ nɛn yɛnuɡibu, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ sɑ ko sɑ̃.
Mɑ tɔn be, bɑ nùn wisɑ bɑ nɛɛ, sɑ ǹ Yinni Gusunɔ derimɔ su bũnu sɑ̃ pɑi!

Domi wiyɑ bɛsɛn Yinni wi u sun yɑrɑmɑ sɑɑ Eɡibitiɡibun yorun di, bɛsɛ kɑ bɛsɛn bɑɑbɑbɑ. U mɑɑ sɔm mɑɑmɑɑkiɡii dɑbinu kuɑ bɛsɛn nɔni biru. Mɑ u sun kɔ̃su bɑɑmɑ mi sɑ dɑ kpuro bɛsɛn sɑnum sɔɔ kɑ bwese tukunun suunu sɔɔ.
Mɑ u sun bwese dɑbinu ɡirɑ, kɑ mɑm Amɔrebɑ be bɑ rɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ tem mɛ sɔɔ. Yen sɔ̃nɑ sɑ ko Yinni Gusunɔ sɑ̃. Domi u sɑ̃ɑwɑ bɛsɛn Yinni kɑ ɡem.

Yosue u tɔn be sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, yɑ sɛ̃ i kɑ Yinni Gusunɔ sɑ̃ domi u sɑ̃ɑwɑ dɛɛro, u ǹ wurɑmɔ i mɑɑ ɡoo sɑ̃. Yen sɔ̃, ì n nùn deri mɑ i bũnu sɑ̃wɑ, u ǹ bɛɛ bɛɛn durum suuru kuɑmmɛ. Bɑɑ mɛ u bɛɛ ɡeɑ kuɑ kɔ, u koo ɡɔsirɑwɑ u bɛɛ kɔ̃sɑ kuɑ kpɑ u bɛɛ kɑm koosiɑ.
Mɑ tɔn be, bɑ Yosue sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, bɑɑ ǹ n mɛren nɑ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ sɑ ko sɑ̃.
Yosue u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bɛɛ, i bɛɛn tii seedɑ diiyɑ mɑ Yinni Gusunɔwɑ i ɡɔsɑ i sɑ̃. Mɑ bɑ nɛɛ, mɛyɑ sɑ ɡeruɑ.
Mɑ u nɛɛ, ǹ n mɛn nɑ, i bũnu wunɔ i kɔ̃ ni nu wɑ̃ɑ bɛɛn suunu sɔɔ, kpɑ i tii Gusunɔ bɛsɛn Yinni wɛ̃.
Mɑ tɔn be, bɑ Yosue sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, Gusunɔ bɛsɛn Yinniwɑ sɑ ko sɑ̃, kpɑ su nùn mɛm nɔɔwɑ.
Dɔmɑ terɑ Yosue u kɑ tɔn be ɑrukɑwɑni bɔkuɑ u bu woodɑ wɛ̃ Sikɛmu mi.
Yen biru u ɡɑri yi yoruɑ Gusunɔn woodɑn tireru sɔɔ mɑ u kpee bɑkɑru suɑ u ɡirɑ dɑ̃ɑ bɑkɑru ɡɑrun nuurɔ mi bɑ Yinni Gusunɔn kuu bekuruɡiru ɡire.

Yosue u tɔn be kpuro sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, wee kpee teni tɑ ko n sɑ̃ɑwɑ bɛsɛn seedɑ domi tɑ ɡɑri kpuro nuɑ yi Yinni Gusunɔ u sun sɔ̃ɔwɑ. Tɑ koo bɛɛ yi yɑɑyɑsiɑ kpɑ i ku rɑ kɑ ko nɑɑnɛ sɑriruɡibu Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑru sɔɔ.
Mɑ Yosue u tɔn be yɑrinɑsiɑ u derɑ ben bɑɑwure u dɑ win tem mɛ u mwɑ sɔɔ.
Yosue kɑ Eleɑsɑɑ bɑ ɡu
Yenibɑ kpuron biru Yosue Nunin bii, Yinni Gusunɔn sɔm kowo u ɡu. U kuɑwɑ wɔ̃ɔ wunɔbu kɑ wɔkuru (110).
Bɑ nùn sikɑ win temɔ Tinnɑti Serɑkiɔ Efɑrɑimun ɡuunun berɑ ɡiɑ, Gɑɑsin ɡuurun sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm ɡeu ɡiɑ.
Isirelibɑ bɑ Yinni Gusunɔ sɑ̃wɑwɑ Yosuen wɑɑti ye kpuro sɔɔ kɑ mɑɑ ɡuro ɡuro be u derin wɑɑti sɔɔ, be bɑ yɛ̃ ye Yinni Gusunɔ u be Isirelibɑ kuɑ ɡesi.

Yosɛfun kuku ni Isirelibɑ bɑ kɑ nɑ Eɡibitin di, bɑ nu sikɑ Sikɛmun tem mɛ sɔɔ, mɛ Yɑkɔbu u dwɑ Hɑmɔrin bii Sikɛmu kɑ win wɔnɔbun mi, kɑ sii ɡeesun ɡobi wunɔbu (100). N deemɑ tem mɛyɑ bɑ Yosɛfun bibun bweseru wɛ̃.
Mɑ Aronin bii Eleɑsɑɑ u mɑɑ ɡu mɑ bɑ nùn sikɑ ɡunɡuru wɔllɔ te bɑ win bii Finɛɛsi wɛ̃. Tɑ wɑ̃ɑwɑ Efɑrɑimun ɡuunun berɑ ɡiɑ.
